title: Evidence and reasoning standard
owner: Methodology and applicable domain standards owner
boundary: Ordinal judgments apply to an exact claim, scope and evidence basis. Contract validation establishes neither semantic sufficiency nor authority. No weighted score, source-count score, automatic approval or claim of calibrated probability.

dimensions.logical-rigor: Make the causal or explanatory chain explicit. Examine assumptions, baseline/business-as-usual, alternatives and unsupported leaps. Coherent prose is not empirical proof.
dimensions.material-coverage: Identify every consequential part, distinguish propositions, reported facts and obligations, and retain missing or challenged conditions. Inventory completeness requires semantic review.
dimensions.evidence-quality: Judge relevant source authority, provenance, method, bias and limitations for this claim. A proposed design or document assertion is not observed runtime or delivered benefit.
dimensions.applicability: Check fit to the named people, jobs, systems, operating conditions, population and time. Explain transfer limits and unknown denominators.
dimensions.independent-patterns: Distinguish independent observations or study families from copied statements, repeated quotations and synthesis of the same material. Describe recurrence, exceptions and denominators; more documents are not more independent evidence.
dimensions.counterevidence: Actively preserve contradictions, negative cases, rival explanations and disconfirming tests. An unresolved material contradiction cannot be averaged away. Lack of supplied counterevidence is not proof that none exists.

levels.not-rated: No defensible scoped confidence judgment is supplied.
levels.low: Plausible but limited, indirect or missing support, material uncertainty, or an unresolved challenge.
levels.moderate: Relevant evidence supports the core claim within explicit limits; no unresolved material contradiction. Explain independence, applicability and remaining gaps.
levels.high: Strong current applicable evidence supports the material claim at the required level; required perspectives and rival explanations have been considered, with no unresolved material contradiction. High is not certainty.

business.purpose: Assess a provisional Business Intent argument for further investigation; no funding, implementation or benefit acceptance is granted.
checks: Connect beneficiaries and situated jobs to the problem and its consequences.
Separate the stated need from the proposed response and the causal mechanism of expected value.
Expose business-as-usual, plausible alternatives, material assumptions and unintended effects.
Identify the applicable scope, obligations, dependencies and what would change the decision.
Specify what meaningful evidence or observation would support or challenge the intended benefit without inventing baselines, targets, owners or commitments.
business.completeness: Whether the argument's material parts, links, assumptions and open questions are explicitly represented for this investigation. This is separate from evidential confidence and from a count of completed fields.

domain-alignment.purpose: Assess the exact requirement, criterion or goal in the selected domain context. Private model recommendations and author refinements are not shared approval.
checks: Apply the same six reasoning and evidence dimensions to the named claim and exact permitted evidence.
Documentary statements and visual prototypes do not prove runtime behavior, causal benefit or delivered outcomes.
Preserve domain-specific applicability, contradictory evidence, independent observation families and unknowns.
domain-alignment.completeness: Coverage of the exact criterion and material conditions in this domain assessment, separate from confidence, ratification and fulfillment.

method_basis.title: HM Treasury Magenta Book 2026
method_basis.use: Theory of change, evaluation evidence, causal inference and context.

method_basis.title: UK Government AQuA Book 2025
method_basis.use: Proportionate analytical quality assurance and documented assumptions.
